direction_notes: Anterior MTL TUS improved accuracy in stable contexts and impaired it in unstable contexts; mPFC TUS improved accuracy in unstable contexts; posterior MTL effects were inconsistent between animals.

timing.protocol_description: 30 ms pulses delivered every 100 ms (30% duty cycle); pulse train of 40 s per hemisphere, bilaterally, delivered offline before the behavioural session; sham had the transducer in place but not activated.

target.label: anterior medial temporal lobe (aMTL), primarily anterior hippocampus

flags.reason: Discussion states intensity 10 W/cm2 while Methods free-field measurement gives Isppa 11.5 W/cm2; Methods value recorded.
Only two animals; one male, one female, each serving as own control.
PRF from the Discussion (10 Hz pulse frequency); Methods give a 100 ms pulse repetition interval.
Simulations with k-Plan were run for targeting but no in situ pressure or intensity values are reported in the main text.
Earplugs worn during sonication; the paper notes these do not eliminate noise confounds fully.
Sessions were counterbalanced; Monkey PL initially had a blocked design.
